text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Symboli Rudolf came to me with a 
serious expression to ask for advice—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive the short notice. There is a place 
I'd like you to accompany me to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I go alone, I— might just collapse 
right on the spot...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of place could make her say 
all that...? For now, I decided to go 
along with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place Symboli Rudolf guided me to was 
a specialty T-shirt shop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“New York Nyuyoku”... “Chasing yams and 
melons”...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Terrifying as always, this shop. 
If one were to come alone, they'd be 
laughed right out the door.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Every single shirt features a 
splendid joke printed in a simple 
typeface, does it not?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I found it while looking for topics for a 
fireside chat. I've been wanting to take a 
proper look through it.
choice_data_list:
...So you found it while looking for 
material?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mm, that is one way to put it. "Humor 
takes effort. Daily gathering of material 
and honing one's delivery are essential."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A book I read recently called "You Can Do 
It! Becoming a Fun Person" said as much, 
so I am using it as a reference.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a great book, too—straightforward and 
to the point. Would you like to borrow it 
sometime, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Mm. Just say the word anytime.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, to the main point. If I pull off 
wearing this shirt, I believe everyone at 
the academy will be rolling in the aisles, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mmhââ Indeed, these are refined and 
exceptional gags.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, there is indeed a chance it 
might not get across, huh... If that 
happens, it would defeat the whole 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. Let's avoid showing this off 
too widely."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...That being said, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For future reference, I would like to buy 
one... as a "comedy racing outfit."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. If you don't mind, could you 
help me choose?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I went into the shop with 
Symboli Rudolf to pick out T-shirts, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: K-Fufu...! This is bad, I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stifling our laughter, we somehow manage 
to make our choice, coming away with one 
supreme photo and a cherished little 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. If I were to suddenly appear 
wearing this, the entire academy would 
erupt into laughter."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, it might lead to 
excessive chaos...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That was a close call. Thank you for 
pointing it out."
